title: Update on Dengue Cases and Measures to Contain Its Spread
what_it_is: Update on Dengue Cases and Measures to Contain Its Spread

sections.label: Dengue cases and Wolbachia questions
sections.summary: Questions asked about expediting Project Wolbachia, allocating more NEA resources, and reasons for rising dengue cases, attributed to mosquito population, warmer weather and lower herd immunity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether the Ministry will consider expediting the trial of Project Wolbachia in the top dengue clusters, given the high success rate of this project in eradicating the Aedes mosquito populations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources whether NEA can consider allocating more resources to step up efforts in eradicating mosquito breeding habitats through surveillance and inspections.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources what are the reasons for the continuing increase in the number of dengue cases this year despite the increase in mitigation measures, such as fogging and inspections, that have been taken in reported dengue clusters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Based on the National Environment Agency's (NEA's) surveillance, the surge in dengue cases this year is attributable to three key factors: an increase in mosquito population; the relatively warmer weather; and lower herd immunity in our population.

sections.label: NEA inspections and breeding habitats
sections.summary: In the first six months, NEA conducted over 442,000 island-wide inspections and found about 8,200 mosquito breeding habitats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In the first six months of the year, NEA has conducted more than 442,000 inspections island-wide and uncovered about 8,200 mosquito breeding habitats.

sections.label: Dengue clusters closed in 2019
sections.summary: As of 24 August, 863 of the 1,021 clusters formed in 2019 had been closed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As of 24 August, we have closed 863 of the 1,021 clusters formed in 2019.

sections.label: Wolbachia release area and strategies
sections.summary: The release area covers 84 Yishun and 60 Tampines blocks, is 3.7 times larger than at Wolbachia's start, and focuses on automating production and release.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The release area covers 84 blocks in Yishun and 60 blocks in Tampines and is 3.7 times larger than the release area when Wolbachia first started.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It also focuses on the development of automation for male Wolbachia-Aedes mosquito production and release to ensure scalability of the technology.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Wolbachia technology is also not a silver bullet.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Comprehensive mosquito surveillance, source eradication of mosquito breeding habitats, and spraying of insecticide where necessary to control the adult mosquito population, continue to be Singapore's key strategies for dengue prevention and control.

sections.label: Herd immunity and serotype discussion
sections.summary: Low herd immunity, not a serotype switch, is cited as a major factor in the dengue spike, with questions on overseas infections and differences between private and public housing breeding places.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Earlier, he talked about lower herd immunity and attributed it to the fact that the dengue prevention efforts of the past years have shown some effectiveness.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: There is no known significant switch in serotype of dengue strains found in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: So, as I have mentioned, the three factors, among which is the low herd immunity, is one major factor which is causing the spike in the number of dengue cases in Singapore, rather than serotype switch.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Are there incidents of them contracting dengue overseas because they let their guards down or they are not aware that the regions that they visit are also experiencing a dengue outbreak?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: There are clear differences between breeding places in private estates and public housing.
